title: Van Haven Client Core
description: Client mod for the Van Haven server
body:
# Van Haven Client Core

The client mod for the Van Haven Cobblemon server.

## Features
 * Client-side hooks for custom multi-battles
 * Highly configurable cosmetics able to be added via data and resource pack 
   (mega showdown gimmicks compatible) 

## Requirements

* Minecraft 1.21.1
* NeoForge 21.1.200 or newer
* Cobblemon 1.7.3
* Accessories 1.1.0-beta.52
* GeckoLib 4.8.3
* Mega Showdown 1.7.3
> KotlinForForge and Architectury come with Cobblemon.

## Notes

You need a custom raid mod for this to work outside Van Haven.
